topic: Request for client asset report and meeting
summary_markdown: Someone requested a report for the Joe&TheJuice client covering all assigned boxes, including box MAC, box name, assigned facility name, and facility ID. Later, someone asked to schedule a meeting (tomorrow or Monday) to discuss necessary asset changes.

Schedule a follow-up meeting to discuss asset changes.
